policy: Historical physical-request DAG with every local computation, dispatch delay, queue wait, and persistence cost optimistically set to zero. Measured transport times stay whole. This is not a prediction or a universal latency bound.

dependencyEvidence.preparation: Known action compilation overlaps resumed AgentMind; resumed compilation waits for its AgentMind. Perception waits for both branches. eager-reference.ts prepare path.
dependencyEvidence.perception: Two sequential perception rounds, each with one dependent repair; committed-check context and Ledger sequence establish the order. truth-engine.ts runOnsetPerceptionStage.
dependencyEvidence.reaction: Six private reactions follow accepted perception; replacement compilation follows the finite reaction set. eager-reference.ts preparation/completion boundary.
dependencyEvidence.planning: Two physical plan batches run concurrently; each plan-verification batch has the same assigned action set as its producer. Logical source membership is retained in the inventory.
dependencyEvidence.continuation: The continuation batch contains the 22-action and 3-action components from p21. Duke Caedwine transitions separately after p24. The remaining transitions depend on continuation and reviewed plans; p27 also includes Bedewald from p22.
dependencyEvidence.randomOrder: Components sort by their smallest action ID. Duke is ordinal 0, the 22-action component ordinal 1, the 3-action continuation component ordinal 9, and the p22 components ordinals 12-20. OrderedRandomStream.finish waits for predecessors before transition.
dependencyEvidence.commit: Global observation waits for all transitions; final causal review waits for the assembled observation candidate. Local validation and persistence are zero in this optimistic DAG.
